result.topic_en: Draft of a reply, written on the back of a printed postal ledger form, about Riemann's paper 'Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen': it addresses a suggestion to add illustrative examples to the second part and drafts definitions of simply and doubly connected surfaces via cross-cuts.
